name: חִלְקִיָּהוּ
summary: Above all Hilkiah the high priest in Josiah's reign, who found the scroll of the law in the house of Yahweh (2Ki 22:8) and cleared Baal's vessels out of the temple (2Ki 23:4); also the father of Eliakim, Hezekiah's officer over the house (2Ki 18:18; Isa 22:20), the priest of Anathoth who was Jeremiah's father (Jer 1:1), a Merarite Levite (1Ch 6:30), a gatekeeper (1Ch 26:11), and priests of the return (Neh 8:4; 12:7, 21). The name is חֵלֶק “portion” with “my” and יָהוּ: “my portion is Yahweh”, the words Yahweh spoke to Aaron, “I am your portion” (Num 18:20), and fitting that so many who bore it were priests and Levites. The Punic name ʾšmnḥlq, “Eshmun is my lot”, is built the same way.

evidence.note: “Hilkiah the high priest said to Shaphan the scribe, I have found the scroll of the law in the house of Yahweh.”
“Eliakim son of Hilkiah, who was over the house.”
“Jeremiah son of Hilkiah, of the priests who were in Anathoth.”
In the high priests' line: “Shallum fathered Hilkiah, and Hilkiah fathered Azariah.”
A Levite of Merari, son of Amzi.
Standing at Ezra's right hand at the reading of the law.
Among the heads of the priests in the days of Jeshua.
The priestly house “of Hilkiah” in the days of Joiakim.
“I am your portion (חֶלְקְךָ) and your inheritance among the sons of Israel”: Yahweh to Aaron, the meaning of the name.
“Yahweh is my portion (חֶלְקִי)”: the name as a sentence.

note: Takes h.da.aj (34 tokens, spellings חִלְקִיָּהוּ and חִלְקִיָּה). TIPNR's Hilkiah@1Ch.6.45 is 1Ch 6:30 in the Hebrew numbering; it files the father of Gemariah (Jer 29:3) under the high priest 2Ki.22.4, and has no record for the Hilkiah of Neh 11:11 / 1Ch 9:11 (ancestor of Seraiah/Azariah, the same high-priestly line) or of Neh 12:21 beyond Neh.12.7. The meaning “my portion is Yahweh” reads חִלְקִי as חֵלֶק with the suffix, as in Psa 119:57; no verse explains the name.
